observations: Three photos show a Nightstick headlamp in its original packaging.

Photo 0: Two identical packages of the headlamp are visible, one slightly overlapping the other. The packaging is white and black with yellow accents. The headlamp is lime green with a silver lens. Text on the packaging includes 'NIGHTSTICK', 'HEADLAMP', 'CLASS I DIV 1', 'ZONE 0', '90 LUMENS', and 'INTRINSICALLY SAFE'. Three AAA batteries are included in a clear plastic tray.

Photo 1: Close-up of one package. The brand 'NIGHTSTICK' is clearly visible at the top. Below it, 'HEADLAMP' and 'INTRINSICALLY SAFE XPP-5450G' are printed. Yellow circles highlight 'CLASS I DIV 1' and 'ZONE 0'. The '90 LUMENS' claim is prominent. The included batteries are labeled 'Energizer MAX'.

Photo 2: Back of the packaging. The model number 'XPP-5450G' is visible. Features listed include 'High-brightness spotlight', 'Single switch operation', 'Adjustable ratchet tilt head', 'Non-slip elastic head strap', 'Heavy-duty rubber strap', and 'Impact & chemical-resistant'. The package includes the light, elastic headband, rubber headband, batteries (3AAA), and instruction manual. A 'Limited lifetime warranty' is mentioned. The bottom includes 'nightstick.com', contact info, 'Designed in Texas, USA, Manufactured in China', and CE marking.
All photos show the item in sealed retail packaging. No signs of damage or tampering are visible.

risks.proof: A close-up of the packaging's holographic security seal or serial number, or a video showing the item being unboxed and powered on with the original batteries.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic headlamp, not a genuine Nightstick, which would significantly reduce value.

risks.risk: The batteries may be expired or non-functional.
risks.proof: A close-up of the battery expiration date or a video showing the headlamp powered on with the included batteries.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if batteries are non-functional or expired, reducing value.

risks.risk: The headlamp may be defective or not work as advertised.
risks.proof: A video showing the headlamp turned on and off, demonstrating the beam and brightness.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, which is the worst-case scenario for a used electronic item.

proof_requests: A close-up of the battery expiration date.
A video showing the headlamp powered on with the included batteries.
A close-up of any holographic security seal or serial number on the packaging.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a genuine Nightstick XPP-5450G headlamp based on clear branding and model number. All seller claims are supported by the packaging. However, critical hidden risks remain: the functionality of the headlamp and the condition of the batteries cannot be verified from photos alone. These risks must be resolved before pricing can be determined accurately.
